Transkingdom & Multi-Omics Bipartite Network Type

Source: R/type_bipartite.R
type_bipartite.Rd

Creates a publication-grade bipartite interaction network connecting two biological domains or kingdoms (e.g., Bacteria vs Fungi, or Gut Microbiota vs Serum Metabolites) with signed correlation edges and cross-domain hub highlighting (Wen et al. iMeta 2025).

Usage

type_bipartite(
  domain_a = "Bacteria",
  domain_b = "Fungi",
  layout = c("bipolar", "concentric", "parallel"),
  edge_color_pos = "#4DBBD5",
  edge_color_neg = "#E64B35",
  edge_alpha = 0.65,
  edge_width_range = c(0.3, 1.8),
  node_color_a = "#3B4992",
  node_color_b = "#008B45",
  node_size_range = c(2.5, 6.5),
  label_top = 5,
  label_size = 2.8,
  cor_cutoff = 0.35,
  p_cutoff = 0.05,
  nodes = NULL,
  edges = NULL
)

Arguments

domain_a

Character label for Domain A (default "Bacteria").

domain_b

Character label for Domain B (default "Fungi").

layout

Character string specifying spatial arrangement: "bipolar" (default, two facing vertical or circular columns), "concentric" (Domain A in inner circle, Domain B in outer ring), or "parallel".

edge_color_pos

Color for positive cross-domain correlations (default "#4DBBD5", cyan).

edge_color_neg

Color for negative cross-domain correlations (default "#E64B35", coral red).

edge_alpha

Numeric transparency for cross-domain edges (default 0.65).

edge_width_range

Range of line widths mapped to absolute correlation strength (default c(0.3, 1.8)).

node_color_a

Color for Domain A nodes (default "#3B4992", deep royal blue).

node_color_b

Color for Domain B nodes (default "#008B45", emerald green).

node_size_range

Numeric vector of length 2 specifying point sizes mapped to degree (default c(2.5, 6.5)).

label_top

Integer. Number of top cross-domain hubs to label per domain (default 5).

label_size

Numeric font size for node labels (default 2.8).

cor_cutoff

Numeric minimum absolute correlation threshold to include edges (default 0.35).

p_cutoff

Numeric p-value threshold for edge significance (default 0.05).

nodes

Optional data frame of nodes with columns node, domain, and optional phylum.

edges

Optional data frame of edges with columns from, to, cor (or weight), and optional p_value.

Value

A cliplot_type object for use with cliplot.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
cliplot(type = type_bipartite(domain_a = "Bacteria", domain_b = "Metabolites",
                              nodes = nodes_df, edges = edges_df))
} # }
